INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. When learning Word Processing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

4. When learning The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.
   D. Skip safety briefings for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.

5. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.

6. When learning Introduction to ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Operating Systems and Utilities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating Systems and Utilities.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating Systems and Utilities.

9. When learning Desktop Publishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing.

10. When learning Presentation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Presentation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Presentation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Presentation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Presentation.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. When learning Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Information and Communication Technology

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing.

3. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT.

7. A — CPU

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating Systems and Utilities.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Presentation.

11. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Internet; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to ICT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
